steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each item is placed by its plan line, its spend against plan, and its payback basis.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 item was bought with no plan line

findings.title: Item bought with no plan line
findings.fix: Get approval for the item or stop the purchase

findings.title: Item over plan with no reason
findings.fix: Give the reason for the overrun

findings.title: Payback with no basis
findings.fix: State the basis for the payback

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[medium] capex-robot.md:19  Item over plan with no reason.

Not checked: Equipment performance on the line.
pros: Checks an item over plan with no reason, a payback with no basis, and an item bought with no plan line.
cons: Not checked: Equipment performance on the line.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-capex-review skill on the records for this review.
